premises.statement: Classical logical equality, finite/countable records, functions, subsets, quotient sets and induction. No claim that proof logic itself is derived from a cut.
Free typed recursion on first-cut and self-cut-of-trace event tags, based at a first-cut seed. Not uniquely forced by the original prose.
On the free signed role ledger, exchange swaps the named roles and parity negates the self-cut role. Definitions, not asserted laws of arbitrary raw chi/kappa.
Equal-weight matching of the two marked role coefficients; no physical metric uniqueness asserted.
Every finite prefix is observable, with termination retained. Other observation policies can induce different recognition quotients.
Use native halving 2^-prefix_length. Other rational contraction ratios generate the same topology; no unique physical scale asserted.
